title: Authenticated current-image VR cache migration and revoked-library browser acceptance
classification: FE-001 follow-up: current desktop Chromium application scenario verified; supported physical headset and fully offline upgrade acceptance remain open.

environment.server: Native Docker app started by normal entrypoint/startweb path; dedicated PostgreSQL database, isolated volumes, game mount read-only, background workers disabled.
environment.data: Three synthetic users and two real VR games. Child initially granted only the shared library; no external provider credentials.
environment.network: App on owned Docker internal network with no external egress; browser private/auth/worker requests relayed to real app via Docker exec. Public static bundles and default theme copied from the exact image and served locally to avoid relay overhead.
environment.first_boot_guard: Initial synthetic PostgreSQL default-password refusal was expected. Explicit legacy compatibility used only for the pre-existing dedicated review database; production guard unchanged.

captures.publication: Captures retained privately, no screenshots committed.

harness_rework: Seed helper needed explicit installed psycopg2 driver; application driver compatibility already worked.
System Playwright expected missing newer headless-shell cache; used existing Chromium executable and recorded actual version.

Initial per-asset Docker relay exceeded the 20-second navigation bound. Public built assets copied from tested image, navigation bound raised to 60 seconds, and actual empty-state text used. Failed attempts retained privately.
limits: This is desktop Chromium, not a physical supported-headset or packaged companion qualification.
Historical worker served only by an owned review proxy; old-client disclosure precondition is distinct from updated-current-app behavior.
Public assets use exact-image bytes through the review relay; this does not independently qualify all production static response headers or performance.
Fully offline clients cannot receive the retirement update.
Single current-image acceptance does not promote the immutable R1972 paired route coverage or establish whole-product parity.
Unrestricted current-source test run and current CI remain pending.
capture: Private real populated synthetic-app online/offline captures inspected; no UI code/layout change.
